full_track.tags: Folk-pop instrumental featuring a prominent violin melody. The arrangement centers on a bright, staccato violin playing a syncopated, folk-inspired lead. A clean acoustic guitar provides rhythmic accompaniment with steady eighth-note strumming. A double bass plays a simple root-note pattern on beats one and three. The percussion consists of a light shaker and a subtle kick drum on the downbeats. The track is in the key of G Major with a tempo of 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The structure alternates between the violin-led melody and sections where the acoustic guitar takes a more prominent rhythmic role with percussive strums.
